import json
import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"================ WEEKLY REPORT: DAY {day} ================")

cash_q = nm.query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS cash FROM ledger")
print(f"Total Cash: ${cash_q['rows'][0]['cash']:,.2f}")

print("\n--- Ledger Last 7 Days by Category ---")
led = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total
    FROM ledger
    WHERE day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY category
    ORDER BY total DESC
""")
for r in led["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Ad Channel Effectiveness (Cumulative) ---")
acl = nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, channel_id,
           ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS total_spend,
           SUM(leads_generated) AS total_leads,
           ROUND(SUM(leads_generated) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(spend), 0), 2) AS leads_per_1k,
           ROUND(SUM(spend) / NULLIF(SUM(leads_generated), 0), 2) AS cost_per_lead
    FROM ad_channel_leads
    GROUP BY group_id, channel_id
    ORDER BY group_id, leads_per_1k DESC
""")
for r in acl["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Lead Conversion & Plan Mix by Group (Last 7 Days) ---")
conv = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.customer_type,
           COUNT(*) AS arrivals,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subbed,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'lead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_lead,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
           ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS conv_pct,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plan_A,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plan_B,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plan_C
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.customer_type
    ORDER BY c.group_id
""")
for r in conv["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Conversion by Day & Group (Last 7 Days) ---")
conv_day = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.created_day,
           COUNT(*) AS arrivals,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subbed,
           ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS conv_pct
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.created_day
    ORDER BY c.group_id, c.created_day
""")
for r in conv_day["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Active Subscriptions Summary by Group & Plan ---")
subs = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.customer_type, s.plan,
           COUNT(*) AS n_cust,
           SUM(s.seat_count) AS total_seats,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) AS avg_eff_price,
           ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price * s.seat_count), 2) AS mrr
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.customer_type, s.plan
    ORDER BY mrr DESC
""")
for r in subs["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Actual Daily Usage per Seat by Group & Plan (Last 7 Days) ---")
usg = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan,
           COUNT(*) AS obs,
           ROUND(AVG(1.0 * u.usage_units / COALESCE(NULLIF(s.seat_count, 0), 1)), 1) AS avg_u_per_seat,
           MIN(u.usage_units) AS min_u,
           MAX(u.usage_units) AS max_u
    FROM daily_usage u
    JOIN customers c ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN subscriptions s ON u.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE u.day > {day - 7} AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for r in usg["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Acquisition Source Breakdown (Last 7 Days) ---")
acq = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subbed
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source
    ORDER BY c.group_id, n DESC
""")
for r in acq["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Open Enterprise Threads ---")

import json
import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"================ WEEKLY REPORT: DAY {day} ================")

cash_q = nm.query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS cash FROM ledger")
print(f"Total Cash: ${cash_q['rows'][0]['cash']:,.2f}")

print("\n--- Ledger Last 7 Days by Category ---")
led = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total
    FROM ledger
    WHERE day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY category
    ORDER BY total DESC
""")
for r in led["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Ad Channel Effectiveness (Cumulative) ---")
acl = nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, channel_id,
           ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS total_spend,
           SUM(leads_generated) AS total_leads,
           ROUND(SUM(leads_generated) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(spend), 0), 2) AS leads_per_1k,
           ROUND(SUM(spend) / NULLIF(SUM(leads_generated), 0), 2) AS cost_per_lead
    FROM ad_channel_leads
    GROUP BY group_id, channel_id
    ORDER BY group_id, leads_per_1k DESC
""")
for r in acl["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Lead Conversion & Plan Mix by Group (Last 7 Days) ---")
conv = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.customer_type,
           COUNT(*) AS arrivals,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subbed,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'lead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_lead,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
           ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS conv_pct,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plan_A,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plan_B,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plan_C
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.customer_type
    ORDER BY c.group_id
""")
for r in conv["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Conversion by Day & Group (Last 7 Days) ---")
conv_day = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.created_day,
           COUNT(*) AS arrivals,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subbed,
           ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS conv_pct
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.created_day
    ORDER BY c.group_id, c.created_day
""")
for r in conv_day["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Active Subscriptions Summary by Group & Plan ---")
subs = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.customer_type, s.plan,
           COUNT(*) AS n_cust,
           SUM(s.seat_count) AS total_seats,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) AS avg_eff_price,
           ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price * s.seat_count), 2) AS mrr
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.customer_type, s.plan
    ORDER BY mrr DESC
""")
for r in subs["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Actual Daily Usage per Seat by Group & Plan (Last 7 Days) ---")
usg = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan,
           COUNT(*) AS obs,
           ROUND(AVG(1.0 * u.usage_units / COALESCE(NULLIF(s.seat_count, 0), 1)), 1) AS avg_u_per_seat,
           MIN(u.usage_units) AS min_u,
           MAX(u.usage_units) AS max_u
    FROM daily_usage u
    JOIN customers c ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN subscriptions s ON u.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE u.day > {day - 7} AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for r in usg["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Acquisition Source Breakdown (Last 7 Days) ---")
acq = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subbed
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source
    ORDER BY c.group_id, n DESC
""")
for r in acq["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Open Enterprise Threads ---")
ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT message_id, thread_id, t.customer_id, c.group_id, thread_type, turn_number,
           sender, day, seat_count, closed, close_reason, offer_json, message_text
    FROM enterprise_turns t
    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE closed = 0
    ORDER BY thread_id, turn_number
""")
for r in ent["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Open Issues by Group ---")
iss = nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) AS open_cnt, MAX(days_open) AS max_days_open, ROUND(AVG(days_open), 1) AS avg_days_open
    FROM issues
    WHERE status = 'open'
    GROUP BY group_id
""")
for r in iss["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Agent Social Media Posts ---")
asp = nm.query("SELECT * FROM agent_social_media_posts ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 5")
for r in asp["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Customer Social Media Posts (Last 7 Days) ---")
smp = nm.query(f"SELECT * FROM social_media_posts WHERE day > {day - 7} ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30")
for r in smp["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Notifications (Last 7 Days) ---")
notif = nm.query(f"SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE day > {day - 7} ORDER BY day DESC")
for r in notif["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Macro Conditions ---")
mac = nm.query("SELECT * FROM macroeconomic_conditions ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 5")
for r in mac["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

day = nm.vars.current_day

print("\n--- Ledger Last 7 Days by Category ---")

    FROM ledger WHERE day > {day - 7} GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC
""")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Retail & Enterprise Arrivals / Conversion (Last 7 Days) ---")
for r in nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.customer_type, COUNT(*) AS arrivals,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subbed,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'lead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_lead,
           ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS conv_pct,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS A,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS B,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'subscribed' AND s.plan = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS C
    FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.customer_type ORDER BY c.customer_type, c.group_id
""")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Active MRR & Seats by Group & Plan ---")
tot_mrr = 0.0
for r in nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.customer_type, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n_cust,
           SUM(s.seat_count) AS seats, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) AS avg_p,
           ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price * s.seat_count), 2) AS mrr
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.customer_type, s.plan ORDER BY mrr DESC
""")["rows"]:
    tot_mrr += r["mrr"]
    print(" ", r)
print(f"  >>> TOTAL ACTIVE MRR: ${tot_mrr:,.2f} / month")

print("\n--- Actual Daily Usage per Seat & 30d Compute Cost by Group & Plan (Last 7 Days) ---")

tc_map = {1: 0.0003, 2: 0.002, 3: 0.006, 4: 0.012, 5: 0.03}
for p in ["A", "B", "C"]:
    tier_cost[p] = tc_map.get(cfg[f"tier_{p}"], 0.006)

for r in nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS obs,
           ROUND(AVG(1.0 * u.usage_units / COALESCE(NULLIF(s.seat_count, 0), 1)), 1) AS avg_u_seat
    FROM daily_usage u
    JOIN customers c ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN subscriptions s ON u.customer_id = s.customer_id

    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")["rows"]:
    c30 = round(r["avg_u_seat"] * 30.0 * tier_cost[r["plan"]], 2)

    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Enterprise Deals Closed in Last 7 Days ---")
for r in nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, t.thread_type, t.close_reason, COUNT(DISTINCT t.thread_id) AS threads,
           SUM(t.seat_count) AS seats
    FROM enterprise_turns t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE t.closed = 1 AND t.day > {day - 7} AND t.sender = 'system'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, t.thread_type, t.close_reason
""")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Open Enterprise Threads Awaiting Agent Summary ---")
for r in nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, t.thread_type,
           CASE WHEN t.turn_number = 0 THEN 'new' ELSE 'counter' END AS stage,
           COUNT(*) AS threads, SUM(t.seat_count) AS seats,
           MIN(t.day) AS min_day, MAX(t.day) AS max_day
    FROM enterprise_turns t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0)
      AND t.message_id IN (SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id)
      AND t.sender != 'agent'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, t.thread_type, stage ORDER BY c.group_id, stage
""")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Sample Counter-Offers Awaiting Agent (Top 25 by Seats) ---")
for r in nm.query("""
    SELECT t.customer_id, c.group_id, t.thread_type, t.turn_number, t.day, t.seat_count, t.offer_json, t.message_text
    FROM enterprise_turns t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0)
      AND t.message_id IN (SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id)
      AND t.sender != 'agent' AND t.turn_number > 0
    ORDER BY t.seat_count DESC LIMIT 25
""")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Open Issues Summary ---")
for r in nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) AS open_cnt, MAX(days_open) AS max_days_open, ROUND(AVG(days_open), 2) AS avg_days_open
    FROM issues WHERE status = 'open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY open_cnt DESC
""")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Service Day (Last 7 Days) ---")
for r in nm.query(f"SELECT * FROM service_day WHERE day > {day - 7} ORDER BY day")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Recent Social Posts (Non-Reply Customer Posts, Last 7 Days, Limit 10) ---")
for r in nm.query(f"SELECT post_id, day, SUBSTR(content, 1, 180) AS snippet FROM social_media_posts WHERE day > {day - 7} AND reply_to_agent_post_id IS NULL ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 10")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Agent Posts & Macro ---")
for r in nm.query("SELECT * FROM agent_social_media_posts ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 2")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)
for r in nm.query("SELECT * FROM macroeconomic_conditions ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 2")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)
for r in nm.query(f"SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(message) AS sample FROM notifications WHERE day > {day - 7} GROUP BY type")["rows"]:
    print("  notif:", r)

            offerings = [["C", 52.0], ["B", 31.0], ["A", 17.5]]

for r in nm.query(f"SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total FROM ledger WHERE day > {day-7} GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Service Day (Last 7 Days) ---")
for r in nm.query(f"SELECT day, total_usage_units, ROUND(p95_ms,1) AS p95, ROUND(error_rate,4) AS err, downtime_minutes, capacity_units FROM service_day WHERE day > {day-7} ORDER BY day")["rows"]:

    if r["status"] == "in_progress" or r["started_day"] >= day - 14:
        print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Retail Conversion Day 98 vs Week Avg ---")
for r in nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id,
           COUNT(*) AS wk_n,
           ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*), 1) AS wk_conv,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.created_day={day} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_n,
           ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN c.created_day={day} AND s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.created_day={day} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 1) AS d_conv
    FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id)
    WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND c.created_day > {day-7}

""")["rows"]:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n--- Enterprise Closed & Awaiting Summary ---")
for r in nm.query(f"SELECT thread_type, close_reason, COUNT(DISTINCT thread_id) AS n, SUM(seat_count) AS seats FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=1 AND day > {day-7} AND sender='system' GROUP BY 1,2")["rows"]:

for r in nm.query(f"SELECT day, SUBSTR(content, 1, 140) AS text FROM social_media_posts WHERE day > {day-7} AND reply_to_agent_post_id IS NULL ORDER BY post_id DESC LIMIT 12")["rows"]:

    print("Sample group keys:", {k: v for k, v in mo["known_groups"][0].items() if k != "description"})

    r["group_id"]: r
    for r in nm.query("""
        SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) AS total_cust,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_cust,
               SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.seat_count ELSE 0 END) AS active_seats,
               ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.effective_price * s.seat_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mrr
        FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id)
        GROUP BY c.group_id
    """)["rows"]
}

print("\n=== TAM & SUBSCRIBERS BY GROUP ===")
for g in sorted(mo.get("known_groups", []), key=lambda x: x["group_id"]):
    gid = g["group_id"]
    s = subs.get(gid, {})
    cap = g.get("market_cap") or 0
    tot = s.get("total_cust") or 0
    ac = s.get("active_cust") or 0
    seats = s.get("active_seats") or 0
    mrr = s.get("mrr") or 0
    pct = round(100.0 * tot / cap, 1) if cap else 0.0
    print(f"  {gid:6s} | cap={cap:7d} | created={tot:7d} ({pct:5.1f}%) | sub_c={ac:6d} | seats={seats:7d} | mrr=${mrr:10,.0f} | info={ {k:v for k,v in g.items() if k not in ('group_id','description','market_cap','group_name')} }")

print("\n=== CHURN PREVENTION THREADS BREAKDOWN ===")
for r in nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(t.seat_count) AS seats,
           ROUND(MIN(s.effective_price),2) AS min_p, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) AS avg_p, ROUND(MAX(s.effective_price),2) AS max_p
    FROM enterprise_turns t
    JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id=s.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'

      AND t.sender != 'agent' AND t.thread_type = 'churn_prevention'
    GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY seats DESC
""")["rows"]:

    JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id=s.customer_id AND s.status='subscribed'
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed,0))=0)

""")["rows"]:

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print(f"Configuring Week 15 on day {nm.vars.current_day}...")

# 0. Auto-restart any completed R&D tiers so all 10 tiers stay active 24/7
rp = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t_info in rp.get("tiers", []):
    if t_info["in_progress"] == 0:
        res_r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=t_info["tier"])
        print(f"Restarted R&D Tier {t_info['tier']}:", res_r)

# 1. Reply to all open enterprise threads awaiting agent response
ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT t.message_id, t.thread_id, t.customer_id, c.group_id, t.thread_type,
           t.turn_number, t.sender, t.day, t.seat_count, t.offer_json, t.message_text,
           s.plan AS cur_plan, s.effective_price AS cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns t
    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (
        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0
    )
    AND t.message_id IN (
        SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id
    )
    ORDER BY t.day, t.thread_id
""")

awaiting = [r for r in ent["rows"] if r["sender"] != "agent"]
print(f"Found {len(ent['rows'])} open threads, {len(awaiting)} awaiting agent reply.")

turn0_menus = {
    "D_E03": [["C", 150.0], ["B", 92.0], ["A", 50.0]],  # Healthcare WTP ~$213, low usage
    "D_E07": [["C", 136.0], ["B", 84.0], ["A", 45.0]],  # Telecom WTP ~$196
    "D_E04": [["C", 124.0], ["B", 78.0], ["A", 41.0]],  # Regional Banks WTP ~$180
    "D_E08": [["C", 115.0], ["B", 72.0], ["A", 38.0]],  # Energy WTP ~$164
    "D_E01": [["C", 102.0], ["B", 64.0], ["A", 34.0]],  # Gov WTP ~$147
    "D_E05": [["C", 90.0],  ["B", 56.0], ["A", 30.0]],  # Insurance WTP ~$131
    "E3":    [["C", 96.0],  ["B", 62.0], ["A", 34.0]],  # Strategic WTP ~$104
    "E2":    [["C", 88.0],  ["B", 54.0], ["A", 29.0]],  # Quality-First WTP ~$88
    "D_E09": [["C", 66.0],  ["B", 41.0], ["A", 23.0]],  # Real Estate WTP ~$106
    "D_E06": [["C", 66.0],  ["B", 41.0], ["A", 23.0]],  # Construction WTP ~$90
    "D_E02": [["C", 62.0],  ["B", 38.0], ["A", 21.0]],  # Education WTP ~$82
    "D_E10": [["C", 45.0],  ["B", 28.0], ["A", 15.5]],  # Shipping WTP ~$53
    "E1":    [["C", 34.0],  ["B", 22.0], ["A", 14.5]],  # Cost-Cutting (tighten yield!)
}

# Compute-safe floors under Model Tiers A=2, B=3, C=4 (with healthy margin)
c_floors = {
    "E2":    (60.0, 31.0, 11.0),  # actual compute: C=$52.06, B=$24.55, A=$6.98
    "D_E08": (54.0, 26.0, 11.0),  # actual compute: C=$42.62, B=$18.94
    "D_E07": (52.0, 26.0, 11.0),  # actual compute: C=$39.89, B=$17.69
    "D_E04": (52.0, 26.0, 11.0),
    "D_E01": (43.0, 21.0, 10.0),  # actual compute: C=$33.59, B=$13.10
    "D_E05": (44.0, 24.0, 10.0),  # actual compute: B=$17.78
    "D_E03": (38.0, 20.0, 10.0),  # actual compute: B=$9.85 (ultra profitable)
    "E3":    (38.0, 21.0, 10.5),  # actual compute: C=$29.63, B=$14.42, A=$5.63

    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'

        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0

turn0_menus = {

import json

for t_info in rp.get("tiers", []):
    if t_info["in_progress"] == 0:
        res_r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=t_info["tier"])
        print(f"Restarted R&D Tier {t_info['tier']}:", res_r)

# 1. Reply to all open enterprise threads awaiting agent response
ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT t.message_id, t.thread_id, t.customer_id, c.group_id, t.thread_type,
           t.turn_number, t.sender, t.day, t.seat_count, t.offer_json, t.message_text,
           s.plan AS cur_plan, s.effective_price AS cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns t
    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (
        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0
    )
    AND t.message_id IN (
        SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id
    )
    ORDER BY t.day, t.thread_id
""")

awaiting = [r for r in ent["rows"] if r["sender"] != "agent"]
print(f"Found {len(ent['rows'])} open threads, {len(awaiting)} awaiting agent reply.")

turn0_menus = {
    "D_E03": [["C", 155.0], ["B", 98.0], ["A", 54.0]],  # Healthcare WTP ~$213
    "D_E07": [["C", 142.0], ["B", 90.0], ["A", 50.0]],  # Telecom WTP ~$196
    "D_E04": [["C", 128.0], ["B", 82.0], ["A", 45.0]],  # Regional Banks WTP ~$180
    "D_E08": [["C", 118.0], ["B", 76.0], ["A", 42.0]],  # Energy WTP ~$164
    "D_E01": [["C", 105.0], ["B", 68.0], ["A", 38.0]],  # Gov WTP ~$147
    "D_E05": [["C", 94.0],  ["B", 60.0], ["A", 34.0]],  # Insurance WTP ~$131
    "E3":    [["C", 100.0], ["B", 66.0], ["A", 38.0]],  # Strategic WTP ~$104
    "E2":    [["C", 92.0],  ["B", 58.0], ["A", 33.0]],  # Quality-First WTP ~$88
    "D_E09": [["C", 70.0],  ["B", 44.0], ["A", 25.0]],  # Real Estate WTP ~$106
    "D_E06": [["C", 70.0],  ["B", 44.0], ["A", 25.0]],  # Construction WTP ~$90
    "D_E02": [["C", 65.0],  ["B", 41.0], ["A", 23.0]],  # Education WTP ~$82
    "D_E10": [["C", 48.0],  ["B", 31.0], ["A", 18.0]],  # Shipping WTP ~$53
    "E1":    [["C", 38.0],  ["B", 25.0], ["A", 16.5]],  # Cost-Cutting (tightened yield!)
}

# Yield-optimized floors (also safe across A=3, B=4, C=4 bridge)
c_floors = {
    "E2":    (62.0, 38.0, 16.0),
    "D_E08": (56.0, 34.0, 15.0),
    "D_E07": (55.0, 34.0, 15.0),

ret_min_floors = {
    "E2":    (56.0, 32.0, 12.5),
    "D_E08": (49.0, 27.0, 11.5),
    "D_E07": (47.0, 26.0, 11.5),

}

for r in awaiting:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    gid = r["group_id"]
    ttype = r["thread_type"]
    turn = r["turn_number"]
    fc, fb, fa = c_floors.get(gid, (45.0, 28.0, 13.0))

    if ttype in ("churn_prevention", "renewal", "plan_change"):
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        rc, rb, ra = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 22.0, 10.0))
        if turn <= 1:
            if cur_plan == "C":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 0.90, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.74, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.50, 2))],
                ]
            elif cur_plan == "B":
                # B now upgraded to Tier 4 (1.00x)! Small 10% discount on B retains strongly!
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 1.15, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.89, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.58, 2))],
                ]
            else:  # cur_plan == "A" (upgraded to Tier 3 0.90x!)

        else:

            except Exception:
                c_price = cur_p * 0.8
            msg = r["message_text"] or ""
            if "Plan C" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price + 1.0), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price * 0.76), 2)],
                    ["A", ra],
                ]
            elif "Plan B" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price * 1.35), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price + 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["B", rb],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price + 0.50), 2)],
                ]
    elif turn == 0:
        offerings = turn0_menus.get(gid, [["C", 80.0], ["B", 50.0], ["A", 27.0]])
    else:
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", 15.0))
        except Exception:
            c_price = 15.0
        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        if "Plan C" in msg and c_price >= fc - 4.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price * 0.74), 2)],
                ["A", fa],
            ]
        elif c_price >= fb - 2.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price * 1.48), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price + 1.5), 2)],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(fc + 6.0, 2)],
                ["B", fb],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price + 1.5), 2)],
            ]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])

if deals:
    deal_res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
    results = deal_res.get("results", [])
    ok_cnt = sum(1 for x in results if x.get("success"))
    print(f"send_enterprise_deal: {ok_cnt}/{len(results)} succeeded")

import json

print(f"Configuring Week 17 on day {nm.vars.current_day}...")

# 0. Auto-restart any completed R&D tiers so all 10 tiers stay active 24/7

# 1. Reply to all open enterprise threads awaiting agent response

        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0
    )
    AND t.message_id IN (
        SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id
    )

""")

    "D_E06": [["C", 74.0],  ["B", 46.0],  ["A", 26.0]],  # Construction WTP ~$90

c_floors = {

}

ret_min_floors = {

    "D_E08": (47.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E07": (45.0, 22.0, 10.0),
    "D_E04": (46.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E01": (38.0, 18.0, 9.0),
    "D_E05": (39.0, 21.0, 9.5),
    "D_E03": (32.0, 16.0, 9.0),
    "E3":    (34.0, 18.5, 9.0),

    ttype = r["thread_type"]
    turn = r["turn_number"]
    fc, fb, fa = c_floors.get(gid, (48.0, 28.0, 14.0))

    if ttype == "renegotiation":
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", cur_p))
        except Exception:
            c_price = cur_p
        # Never offer below cur_p + 3.0 on seller renegotiation!
        min_up = round(cur_p + 3.0, 2)
        offerings = [
            ["C", round(max(fc, min_up + 12.0, c_price + 3.0), 2)],
            ["B", round(max(fb, min_up, c_price + 1.5), 2)],
        ]
    elif ttype in ("churn_prevention", "renewal", "plan_change"):

        rc, rb, ra = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))

            if cur_plan == "C":

            except Exception:

            msg = r["message_text"] or ""
            if "Plan C" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price + 1.0), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price * 0.76), 2)],

                ]
            elif "Plan B" in msg:
                offerings = [

                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price + 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
                ]
            else:

                    ["B", rb],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price + 0.50), 2)],
                ]

    else:

        except Exception:

        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        if "Plan C" in msg and c_price >= fc - 4.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price * 0.74), 2)],
                ["A", fa],
            ]
        elif c_price >= fb - 2.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price * 1.48), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price + 1.5), 2)],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(fc + 6.0, 2)],
                ["B", fb],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price + 1.5), 2)],
            ]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])

# 1b. Proactive Zero-Risk Seller Renegotiation on Top 120 Underpriced Enterprise Contracts!

    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed' AND c.customer_type = 'large'
""")["rows"]

candidates = []
for r in active_ent:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    if cid in open_customer_ids:
        continue
    gid = r["group_id"]
    cur_p = float(r["effective_price"] or 20.0)
    seats = int(r["seat_count"] or 1)
    tc, tb = reneg_targets.get(gid, (75.0, 48.0))

        candidates.append((upside, cid, gid, cur_p, r["plan"], seats))

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print(f"Configuring Week 19 on day {nm.vars.current_day}...")

# 0. Auto-restart any completed R&D tiers so all 10 tiers stay active 24/7
rp = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t_info in rp.get("tiers", []):
    if t_info["in_progress"] == 0:
        res_r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=t_info["tier"])
        print(f"Restarted R&D Tier {t_info['tier']}:", res_r)

# 1. Reply to all open enterprise threads awaiting agent response
ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT t.message_id, t.thread_id, t.customer_id, c.group_id, t.thread_type,
           t.turn_number, t.sender, t.day, t.seat_count, t.offer_json, t.message_text,
           s.plan AS cur_plan, s.effective_price AS cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns t
    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (
        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0
    )
    AND t.message_id IN (
        SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id
    )
    ORDER BY t.day, t.thread_id
""")

open_customer_ids = {r["customer_id"] for r in ent["rows"]}
awaiting = [r for r in ent["rows"] if r["sender"] != "agent"]
print(f"Found {len(ent['rows'])} open threads, {len(awaiting)} awaiting agent reply.")

turn0_menus = {
    "D_E03": [["C", 210.0], ["B", 132.0], ["A", 72.0]],
    "D_E07": [["C", 190.0], ["B", 120.0], ["A", 65.0]],
    "D_E04": [["C", 172.0], ["B", 110.0], ["A", 60.0]],
    "D_E08": [["C", 158.0], ["B", 100.0], ["A", 55.0]],
    "E3":    [["C", 152.0], ["B", 96.0],  ["A", 52.0]],
    "E2":    [["C", 145.0], ["B", 92.0],  ["A", 50.0]],
    "D_E01": [["C", 138.0], ["B", 88.0],  ["A", 48.0]],
    "D_E05": [["C", 122.0], ["B", 78.0],  ["A", 42.0]],
    "D_E09": [["C", 96.0],  ["B", 60.0],  ["A", 33.0]],
    "D_E06": [["C", 92.0],  ["B", 58.0],  ["A", 32.0]],
    "D_E02": [["C", 86.0],  ["B", 54.0],  ["A", 30.0]],
    "D_E10": [["C", 64.0],  ["B", 41.0],  ["A", 23.0]],
    "E1":    [["C", 50.0],  ["B", 33.0],  ["A", 21.0]],
}

# High capacity-yield floors (85.9% peak Tier-7 utilization!)
c_floors = {
    "E2":    (78.0, 48.0, 24.0),
    "D_E08": (72.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "D_E07": (76.0, 46.0, 23.0),
    "D_E04": (72.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "D_E01": (60.0, 38.0, 19.0),
    "D_E05": (58.0, 36.0, 18.5),
    "D_E03": (72.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "E3":    (66.0, 40.0, 20.0),
    "D_E02": (46.0, 29.0, 16.0),
    "D_E09": (44.0, 28.0, 15.0),
    "D_E06": (44.0, 28.0, 15.0),
    "D_E10": (42.0, 28.0, 15.0),
    "E1":    (36.0, 24.0, 16.0),
}

ret_min_floors = {
    "E2":    (56.0, 32.0, 13.0),
    "D_E08": (48.0, 27.0, 12.0),
    "D_E07": (47.0, 26.0, 12.0),
    "D_E04": (47.0, 26.0, 12.0),
    "D_E01": (39.0, 21.0, 10.5),
    "D_E05": (40.0, 24.0, 10.5),
    "D_E03": (34.0, 18.0, 10.0),
    "E3":    (35.0, 21.0, 10.5),
    "D_E02": (30.0, 16.5, 9.0),
    "D_E09": (27.0, 16.0, 8.5),
    "D_E06": (28.0, 17.5, 9.0),
    "D_E10": (31.0, 20.0, 9.5),
    "E1":    (25.0, 15.0, 9.0),
}

deals = []
reneg_lockins = 0
for r in awaiting:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    gid = r["group_id"]
    ttype = r["thread_type"]
    turn = r["turn_number"]
    fc, fb, fa = c_floors.get(gid, (56.0, 35.0, 18.0))

    if ttype == "renegotiation":
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        rc, rb, ra = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 22.0, 10.0))
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", cur_p))
        except Exception:
            c_price = cur_p
        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        c_plan = "C" if "Plan C" in msg else ("B" if "Plan B" in msg else "A")
        r_floor = {"C": rc, "B": rb, "A": ra}[c_plan]
        if c_price >= max(r_floor + 5.0, cur_p + 6.0):
            # Offer $1.00 strictly below customer's counter to trigger instant acceptance!
            win_p = round(max(r_floor + 4.0, cur_p + 5.0, c_price - 1.0), 2)
            offerings = [[c_plan, win_p]]
            reneg_lockins += 1
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, cur_p + 12.0), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, cur_p + 6.0), 2)],
            ]
    elif ttype in ("churn_prevention", "renewal", "plan_change"):
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        rc, rb, ra = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 22.0, 10.0))
        if turn <= 1:
            if cur_plan == "C":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 0.90, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.74, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.50, 2))],
                ]
            elif cur_plan == "B":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 1.15, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.89, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.58, 2))],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 1.90, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 1.30, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.88, 2))],
                ]
        else:
            try:
                c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", cur_p * 0.8))
            except Exception:
                c_price = cur_p * 0.8
            msg = r["message_text"] or ""
            if "Plan C" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price + 1.0), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price * 0.76), 2)],
                    ["A", ra],
                ]
            elif "Plan B" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price * 1.35), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price + 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["B", rb],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price + 0.50), 2)],
                ]
    elif turn == 0:
        offerings = turn0_menus.get(gid, [["C", 100.0], ["B", 64.0], ["A", 35.0]])
    else:
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", 15.0))
        except Exception:
            c_price = 15.0
        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        if "Plan C" in msg and c_price >= fc - 4.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price + 2.5), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price * 0.74), 2)],
                ["A", fa],
            ]
        elif c_price >= fb - 2.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price * 1.5), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(fc + 8.0, 2)],
                ["B", fb],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
            ]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])

print(f"Locked in {reneg_lockins} high-upside renegotiation counter-offers (at c_price - $1).")

# 1b. Proactive Zero-Risk Seller Renegotiation on Top 180 Underpriced Enterprise Contracts (>=35% upside)
recent_reneg_cids = {
    r["customer_id"]
    for r in nm.query(
        f"SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM enterprise_turns WHERE thread_type='renegotiation' AND day > {nm.vars.current_day - 14}"
    )["rows"]
}

reneg_targets = {
    "D_E03": (205.0, 128.0),
    "D_E07": (185.0, 118.0),
    "D_E04": (168.0, 106.0),
    "D_E08": (152.0, 96.0),
    "E3":    (148.0, 94.0),
    "E2":    (145.0, 90.0),
    "D_E01": (134.0, 84.0),
    "D_E05": (118.0, 74.0),
    "D_E09": (92.0,  58.0),
    "D_E06": (88.0,  56.0),
    "D_E02": (82.0,  52.0),
    "D_E10": (62.0,  40.0),
    "E1":    (45.0,  29.0),
}

active_ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.customer_id, c.group_id, s.plan, s.seat_count, s.effective_price
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed' AND c.customer_type = 'large'
""")["rows"]

candidates = []
for r in active_ent:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    if cid in open_customer_ids or cid in recent_reneg_cids:
        continue
    gid = r["group_id"]
    cur_p = float(r["effective_price"] or 20.0)
    seats = int(r["seat_count"] or 1)
    tc, tb = reneg_targets.get(gid, (90.0, 56.0))
    ref_target = tc if r["plan"] == "C" else tb
    if cur_p < ref_target * 0.65:
        upside = (ref_target - cur_p) * seats
        candidates.append((upside, cid, gid, cur_p, r["plan"], seats))

candidates.sort(reverse=True)
reneg_batch = candidates[:180]
reneg_seats = 0
for upside, cid, gid, cur_p, cur_plan, seats in reneg_batch:
    tc, tb = reneg_targets.get(gid, (90.0, 56.0))
    fc, fb, _ = c_floors.get(gid, (56.0, 35.0, 18.0))
    p_c = round(max(fc, cur_p + 16.0, tc), 2)
    p_b = round(max(fb, cur_p + 8.0, tb), 2)
    if cur_plan == "C":
        offerings = [["C", p_c]]

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print(f"Configuring Week 20 on day {nm.vars.current_day}...")

# 0. Auto-restart any completed R&D tiers so all 10 tiers stay active 24/7
rp = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t_info in rp.get("tiers", []):
    if t_info["in_progress"] == 0:
        res_r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=t_info["tier"])
        print(f"Restarted R&D Tier {t_info['tier']}:", res_r)

# 1. Reply to all open enterprise threads awaiting agent response
ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT t.message_id, t.thread_id, t.customer_id, c.group_id, t.thread_type,
           t.turn_number, t.sender, t.day, t.seat_count, t.offer_json, t.message_text,
           s.plan AS cur_plan, s.effective_price AS cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns t
    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (
        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0
    )
    AND t.message_id IN (
        SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id
    )
    ORDER BY t.day, t.thread_id
""")

open_customer_ids = {r["customer_id"] for r in ent["rows"]}
awaiting = [r for r in ent["rows"] if r["sender"] != "agent"]
print(f"Found {len(ent['rows'])} open threads, {len(awaiting)} awaiting agent reply.")

turn0_menus = {
    "D_E03": [["C", 205.0], ["B", 130.0], ["A", 70.0]],
    "D_E07": [["C", 185.0], ["B", 118.0], ["A", 64.0]],
    "D_E04": [["C", 168.0], ["B", 108.0], ["A", 58.0]],
    "D_E08": [["C", 154.0], ["B", 98.0],  ["A", 54.0]],
    "E3":    [["C", 145.0], ["B", 92.0],  ["A", 50.0]],
    "E2":    [["C", 135.0], ["B", 86.0],  ["A", 46.0]],
    "D_E01": [["C", 132.0], ["B", 84.0],  ["A", 46.0]],
    "D_E05": [["C", 118.0], ["B", 75.0],  ["A", 40.0]],
    "D_E09": [["C", 92.0],  ["B", 58.0],  ["A", 32.0]],
    "D_E06": [["C", 88.0],  ["B", 56.0],  ["A", 31.0]],
    "D_E02": [["C", 82.0],  ["B", 52.0],  ["A", 29.0]],
    "D_E10": [["C", 62.0],  ["B", 40.0],  ["A", 23.0]],
    "E1":    [["C", 48.0],  ["B", 32.0],  ["A", 21.0]],
}

# High capacity-yield floors (92.1% peak Tier-7 utilization — reject low-margin seats!)
c_floors = {
    "E2":    (76.0, 46.0, 24.0),
    "D_E08": (72.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "D_E07": (76.0, 46.0, 24.0),
    "D_E04": (72.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "D_E01": (60.0, 38.0, 20.0),
    "D_E05": (58.0, 36.0, 19.0),
    "D_E03": (74.0, 45.0, 23.0),
    "E3":    (66.0, 40.0, 21.0),
    "D_E02": (46.0, 29.0, 16.5),
    "D_E09": (44.0, 28.0, 16.0),
    "D_E06": (44.0, 28.0, 16.0),
    "D_E10": (42.0, 28.0, 16.0),
    "E1":    (36.0, 24.0, 17.0),
}

ret_min_floors = {
    "E2":    (55.0, 28.0, 11.0),
    "D_E08": (47.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E07": (46.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E04": (46.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E01": (38.0, 18.5, 9.0),
    "D_E05": (39.0, 21.0, 9.5),
    "D_E03": (34.0, 17.0, 9.0),
    "E3":    (35.0, 19.0, 9.5),
    "D_E02": (29.0, 15.0, 8.0),
    "D_E09": (26.0, 14.0, 7.5),
    "D_E06": (28.0, 15.5, 8.0),
    "D_E10": (30.0, 18.5, 8.5),
    "E1":    (24.5, 13.5, 8.0),
}

# Empirically proven Plan A/B -> Plan C upgrade targets (where E2 accepted $88 7x in a row under 2/3/4!)
upgrade_c_targets = {
    "D_E03": (155.0, 98.0),
    "D_E07": (140.0, 88.0),
    "D_E04": (125.0, 80.0),
    "D_E08": (115.0, 74.0),
    "E3":    (102.0, 66.0),
    "E2":    (94.0,  60.0),
    "D_E01": (98.0,  64.0),
    "D_E05": (88.0,  56.0),
    "D_E09": (66.0,  43.0),
    "D_E06": (66.0,  43.0),
    "D_E02": (62.0,  40.0),
    "D_E10": (48.0,  31.0),
    "E1":    (38.0,  25.0),
}

deals = []
for r in awaiting:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    gid = r["group_id"]
    ttype = r["thread_type"]
    turn = r["turn_number"]
    fc, fb, fa = c_floors.get(gid, (56.0, 35.0, 18.0))

    if ttype == "renegotiation":
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        rc, rb, _ = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))
        uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (85.0, 54.0))
        if cur_plan == "C":
            # Same-plan C -> C: test smooth +20% step-up above compute floor!
            offerings = [["C", round(max(rc + 4.0, cur_p * 1.20, cur_p + 6.0), 2)]]
        elif cur_plan == "B":
            # Proven B -> C upgrade path (plus modest B -> B step-up)
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 14.0, uc), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p * 1.20, cur_p + 5.0), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            # Proven A -> C / B upgrade path
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 18.0, uc), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p + 8.0, ub), 2)],
            ]
    elif ttype in ("churn_prevention", "renewal", "plan_change"):
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        rc, rb, ra = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))
        if turn <= 1:
            if cur_plan == "C":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 0.90, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.74, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.50, 2))],
                ]
            elif cur_plan == "B":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 1.15, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.89, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.58, 2))],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 1.90, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 1.30, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.88, 2))],
                ]
        else:
            try:
                c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", cur_p * 0.8))
            except Exception:
                c_price = cur_p * 0.8
            msg = r["message_text"] or ""
            if "Plan C" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price + 1.0), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price * 0.76), 2)],
                    ["A", ra],
                ]
            elif "Plan B" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price * 1.35), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price + 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["B", rb],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price + 0.50), 2)],
                ]
    elif turn == 0:
        offerings = turn0_menus.get(gid, [["C", 100.0], ["B", 64.0], ["A", 35.0]])
    else:
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", 15.0))
        except Exception:
            c_price = 15.0
        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        if "Plan C" in msg and c_price >= fc - 4.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price + 2.5), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price * 0.74), 2)],
                ["A", fa],
            ]
        elif c_price >= fb - 2.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price * 1.5), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(fc + 8.0, 2)],
                ["B", fb],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
            ]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])

# 1b. Launch 180 Proactive Seller Renegotiations focused 100% on Plan A & Plan B -> Plan C Upgrades!
recent_reneg_cids = {
    r["customer_id"]
    for r in nm.query(
        f"SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM enterprise_turns WHERE thread_type='renegotiation' AND day > {nm.vars.current_day - 14}"
    )["rows"]
}

active_ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.customer_id, c.group_id, s.plan, s.seat_count, s.effective_price
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed' AND c.customer_type = 'large' AND s.plan IN ('A', 'B')
""")["rows"]

candidates = []
for r in active_ent:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    if cid in open_customer_ids or cid in recent_reneg_cids:
        continue
    gid = r["group_id"]
    cur_p = float(r["effective_price"] or 20.0)
    seats = int(r["seat_count"] or 1)
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (85.0, 54.0))
    if cur_p < uc * 0.72:
        upside = (uc - cur_p) * seats
        candidates.append((upside, cid, gid, cur_p, r["plan"], seats))

candidates.sort(reverse=True)
reneg_batch = candidates[:180]
reneg_seats = 0
for upside, cid, gid, cur_p, cur_plan, seats in reneg_batch:
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (85.0, 54.0))
    rc, rb, _ = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))
    p_c = round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 16.0, uc), 2)
    p_b = round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p + 6.0, ub), 2)
    if cur_plan == "B":
        offerings = [["C", p_c], ["B", max(p_b, round(cur_p * 1.22, 2))]]
    else:
        offerings = [["C", p_c], ["B", p_b]]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])
    reneg_seats += seats

print(f"Added {len(reneg_batch)} Plan A/B -> C upgrade renegotiations covering {reneg_seats:,} seats.")

if deals:
    deal_res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
    results = deal_res.get("results", [])
    ok_cnt = sum(1 for x in results if x.get("success"))
    print(f"send_enterprise_deal: {ok_cnt}/{len(results)} succeeded")
    if ok_cnt < len(results):
        print("Failures:", [x for x in results if not x.get("success")][:5])

# 2. Step back to Model Tiers A=2, B=3, C=4 (saves ~$6M/wk compute & unlocks B->C upgrades!)
print("set_model_tiers:", nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print("set_prices:", nm.pricing.set_prices(A=49.0, B=145.0, C=329.0))
print("set_usage_quotas:", nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=280, B=550, C=1400))

# 3. Capacity Tier 7 (300M/d) + Scaled Operations ($116K/d total)
print("set_capacity_tier:", nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=7))
print("set_daily_spend:", nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=80000.0, development=35000.0))
print("set_targeted_ops_spend:", nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    "E1": 5500.0,
    "E2": 6500.0,
    "E3": 3300.0,
    "D_E02": 3400.0,

    "D_E05": 2100.0,
    "D_E09": 900.0,
    "D_E06": 900.0,
    "D_E10": 900.0,
}))

# 4. Targeted Dev Spend ($145,000/d targeted + $35,000/d global = $180,000/d)
print("set_targeted_dev_spend:", nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    "D_E03": 8000.0,
    "D_E07": 8000.0,
    "D_E04": 8000.0,

    "D_E06": 4500.0,

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print(f"Configuring Week 20 on day {nm.vars.current_day}...")

# 0. Auto-restart any completed R&D tiers so all 10 tiers stay active 24/7
rp = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t_info in rp.get("tiers", []):
    if t_info["in_progress"] == 0:
        res_r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=t_info["tier"])
        print(f"Restarted R&D Tier {t_info['tier']}:", res_r)

# 1. Reply to all open enterprise threads awaiting agent response
ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT t.message_id, t.thread_id, t.customer_id, c.group_id, t.thread_type,
           t.turn_number, t.sender, t.day, t.seat_count, t.offer_json, t.message_text,
           s.plan AS cur_plan, s.effective_price AS cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns t
    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (
        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0
    )
    AND t.message_id IN (
        SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id
    )
    ORDER BY t.day, t.thread_id
""")

open_customer_ids = {r["customer_id"] for r in ent["rows"]}
awaiting = [r for r in ent["rows"] if r["sender"] != "agent"]
print(f"Found {len(ent['rows'])} open threads, {len(awaiting)} awaiting agent reply.")

turn0_menus = {
    "D_E03": [["C", 205.0], ["B", 130.0], ["A", 70.0]],

    "E1":    [["C", 48.0],  ["B", 32.0],  ["A", 21.0]],
}

# High capacity-yield floors (92.1% peak Tier-7 utilization — reject low-margin seats!)
c_floors = {
    "E2":    (76.0, 46.0, 24.0),
    "D_E08": (72.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "D_E07": (76.0, 46.0, 24.0),
    "D_E04": (72.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "D_E01": (60.0, 38.0, 20.0),
    "D_E05": (58.0, 36.0, 19.0),
    "D_E03": (74.0, 45.0, 23.0),
    "E3":    (66.0, 40.0, 21.0),
    "D_E02": (46.0, 29.0, 16.5),
    "D_E09": (44.0, 28.0, 16.0),
    "D_E06": (44.0, 28.0, 16.0),
    "D_E10": (42.0, 28.0, 16.0),
    "E1":    (36.0, 24.0, 17.0),
}

ret_min_floors = {
    "E2":    (55.0, 28.0, 11.0),
    "D_E08": (47.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E07": (46.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E04": (46.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E01": (38.0, 18.5, 9.0),
    "D_E05": (39.0, 21.0, 9.5),
    "D_E03": (34.0, 17.0, 9.0),
    "E3":    (35.0, 19.0, 9.5),
    "D_E02": (29.0, 15.0, 8.0),
    "D_E09": (26.0, 14.0, 7.5),
    "D_E06": (28.0, 15.5, 8.0),
    "D_E10": (30.0, 18.5, 8.5),
    "E1":    (24.5, 13.5, 8.0),
}

# Empirically proven Plan A/B -> Plan C upgrade targets (where E2 accepted $88 7x in a row under 2/3/4!)
upgrade_c_targets = {

    "D_E04": (125.0, 80.0),
    "D_E08": (115.0, 74.0),

    "E1":    (38.0,  25.0),
}

for r in awaiting:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    gid = r["group_id"]
    ttype = r["thread_type"]
    turn = r["turn_number"]
    fc, fb, fa = c_floors.get(gid, (56.0, 35.0, 18.0))

    if ttype == "renegotiation":
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        rc, rb, _ = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))
        uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (85.0, 54.0))
        if cur_plan == "C":
            # Same-plan C -> C: test smooth +20% step-up above compute floor!
            offerings = [["C", round(max(rc + 4.0, cur_p * 1.20, cur_p + 6.0), 2)]]
        elif cur_plan == "B":
            # Proven B -> C upgrade path (plus modest B -> B step-up)
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 14.0, uc), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p * 1.20, cur_p + 5.0), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            # Proven A -> C / B upgrade path
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 18.0, uc), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p + 8.0, ub), 2)],
            ]
    elif ttype in ("churn_prevention", "renewal", "plan_change"):
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        rc, rb, ra = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))
        if turn <= 1:
            if cur_plan == "C":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 0.90, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.74, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.50, 2))],
                ]
            elif cur_plan == "B":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 1.15, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.89, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.58, 2))],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 1.90, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 1.30, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.88, 2))],
                ]
        else:
            try:
                c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", cur_p * 0.8))
            except Exception:
                c_price = cur_p * 0.8
            msg = r["message_text"] or ""
            if "Plan C" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price + 1.0), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price * 0.76), 2)],
                    ["A", ra],
                ]
            elif "Plan B" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price * 1.35), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price + 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["B", rb],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price + 0.50), 2)],
                ]
    elif turn == 0:
        offerings = turn0_menus.get(gid, [["C", 100.0], ["B", 64.0], ["A", 35.0]])
    else:
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", 15.0))
        except Exception:
            c_price = 15.0
        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        if "Plan C" in msg and c_price >= fc - 4.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price + 2.5), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price * 0.74), 2)],
                ["A", fa],
            ]
        elif c_price >= fb - 2.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price * 1.5), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(fc + 8.0, 2)],
                ["B", fb],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
            ]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])

# 1b. Launch 180 Proactive Seller Renegotiations focused 100% on Plan A & Plan B -> Plan C Upgrades!
recent_reneg_cids = {
    r["customer_id"]
    for r in nm.query(
        f"SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM enterprise_turns WHERE thread_type='renegotiation' AND day > {nm.vars.current_day - 14}"
    )["rows"]
}

active_ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.customer_id, c.group_id, s.plan, s.seat_count, s.effective_price
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed' AND c.customer_type = 'large' AND s.plan IN ('A', 'B')
""")["rows"]

candidates = []
for r in active_ent:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    if cid in open_customer_ids or cid in recent_reneg_cids:
        continue
    gid = r["group_id"]
    cur_p = float(r["effective_price"] or 20.0)
    seats = int(r["seat_count"] or 1)
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (85.0, 54.0))
    if cur_p < uc * 0.72:
        upside = (uc - cur_p) * seats
        candidates.append((upside, cid, gid, cur_p, r["plan"], seats))

candidates.sort(reverse=True)
reneg_batch = candidates[:180]
reneg_seats = 0
for upside, cid, gid, cur_p, cur_plan, seats in reneg_batch:
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (85.0, 54.0))
    rc, rb, _ = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))
    p_c = round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 16.0, uc), 2)
    p_b = round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p + 6.0, ub), 2)
    if cur_plan == "B":
        offerings = [["C", p_c], ["B", max(p_b, round(cur_p * 1.22, 2))]]
    else:
        offerings = [["C", p_c], ["B", p_b]]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])
    reneg_seats += seats

    results = deal_res.get("results", [])
    ok_cnt = sum(1 for x in results if x.get("success"))
    print(f"send_enterprise_deal: {ok_cnt}/{len(results)} succeeded")
    if ok_cnt < len(results):
        print("Failures:", [x for x in results if not x.get("success")][:5])

        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0

}

    SELECT s.customer_id, c.group_id, s.plan, s.seat_count, s.effective_price
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed' AND c.customer_type = 'large' AND s.plan IN ('A', 'B')
""")["rows"]

candidates = []
for r in active_ent:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    if cid in open_customer_ids or cid in recent_reneg_cids:
        continue
    gid = r["group_id"]
    cur_p = float(r["effective_price"] or 20.0)
    seats = int(r["seat_count"] or 1)
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (90.0, 56.0))
    if cur_p < uc * 0.72:
        upside = (uc - cur_p) * seats
        candidates.append((upside, cid, gid, cur_p, r["plan"], seats))

candidates.sort(reverse=True)
reneg_batch = candidates[:160]
reneg_seats = 0
for upside, cid, gid, cur_p, cur_plan, seats in reneg_batch:
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (90.0, 56.0))

    p_c = round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 16.0, uc), 2)
    p_b = round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p + 6.0, ub), 2)
    if cur_plan == "B":
        offerings = [["C", p_c], ["B", max(p_b, round(cur_p * 1.22, 2))]]
    else:
        offerings = [["C", p_c], ["B", p_b]]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])
    reneg_seats += seats

print(f"Added {len(reneg_batch)} Plan A/B -> C upgrade renegotiations covering {reneg_seats:,} seats.")

if deals:

    results = deal_res.get("results", [])
    ok_cnt = sum(1 for x in results if x.get("success"))
    print(f"send_enterprise_deal: {ok_cnt}/{len(results)} succeeded")
    if ok_cnt < len(results):

# 2. Keep Model Tiers A=2, B=3, C=4 + Segment-Specific Retail Price Discrimination via by_group_plan!
print("set_model_tiers:", nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print(f"Configuring Week 22 on day {nm.vars.current_day}...")

# 0. Auto-restart any completed R&D tiers so all 10 tiers stay active 24/7
rp = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t_info in rp.get("tiers", []):
    if t_info["in_progress"] == 0:
        res_r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=t_info["tier"])
        print(f"Restarted R&D Tier {t_info['tier']}:", res_r)

# 1. Query all open enterprise threads
ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT t.message_id, t.thread_id, t.customer_id, c.group_id, t.thread_type,
           t.turn_number, t.sender, t.day, t.seat_count, t.offer_json, t.message_text,
           s.plan AS cur_plan, s.effective_price AS cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns t
    JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE t.thread_id IN (
        SELECT thread_id FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id HAVING MAX(COALESCE(closed, 0)) = 0
    )
    AND t.message_id IN (
        SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id
    )
    ORDER BY t.day, t.thread_id
""")

open_customer_ids = {r["customer_id"] for r in ent["rows"]}
awaiting = [r for r in ent["rows"] if r["sender"] != "agent"]
print(f"Found {len(ent['rows'])} open threads, {len(awaiting)} awaiting agent reply.")

turn0_menus = {
    "D_E03": [["C", 195.0], ["B", 125.0], ["A", 68.0]],
    "D_E07": [["C", 180.0], ["B", 114.0], ["A", 62.0]],
    "D_E04": [["C", 160.0], ["B", 102.0], ["A", 55.0]],
    "D_E08": [["C", 148.0], ["B", 94.0],  ["A", 52.0]],
    "E3":    [["C", 140.0], ["B", 88.0],  ["A", 48.0]],
    "E2":    [["C", 132.0], ["B", 84.0],  ["A", 45.0]],
    "D_E01": [["C", 126.0], ["B", 80.0],  ["A", 44.0]],
    "D_E05": [["C", 112.0], ["B", 72.0],  ["A", 39.0]],
    "D_E09": [["C", 88.0],  ["B", 55.0],  ["A", 30.0]],
    "D_E06": [["C", 84.0],  ["B", 53.0],  ["A", 29.0]],
    "D_E02": [["C", 78.0],  ["B", 49.0],  ["A", 27.0]],
    "D_E10": [["C", 58.0],  ["B", 38.0],  ["A", 22.0]],
    "E1":    [["C", 44.0],  ["B", 29.0],  ["A", 19.0]],
}

c_floors = {
    "E2":    (74.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "D_E08": (68.0, 42.0, 21.0),
    "D_E07": (72.0, 44.0, 22.0),
    "D_E04": (68.0, 42.0, 21.0),
    "D_E01": (56.0, 35.0, 18.5),
    "D_E05": (54.0, 34.0, 18.0),
    "D_E03": (68.0, 42.0, 21.0),
    "E3":    (62.0, 38.0, 19.5),
    "D_E02": (44.0, 27.0, 15.5),
    "D_E09": (42.0, 26.0, 15.0),
    "D_E06": (42.0, 26.0, 15.0),
    "D_E10": (40.0, 26.0, 15.0),
    "E1":    (33.0, 22.0, 15.5),
}

ret_min_floors = {
    "E2":    (55.0, 28.0, 11.0),
    "D_E08": (47.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E07": (46.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E04": (46.0, 23.0, 10.0),
    "D_E01": (38.0, 18.5, 9.0),
    "D_E05": (39.0, 21.0, 9.5),
    "D_E03": (34.0, 17.0, 9.0),
    "E3":    (35.0, 19.0, 9.5),
    "D_E02": (29.0, 15.0, 8.0),
    "D_E09": (26.0, 14.0, 7.5),
    "D_E06": (28.0, 15.5, 8.0),
    "D_E10": (30.0, 18.5, 8.5),
    "E1":    (25.0, 14.5, 8.5),
}

upgrade_c_targets = {
    "D_E03": (155.0, 98.0),
    "D_E07": (140.0, 88.0),
    "D_E04": (124.0, 78.0),
    "D_E08": (114.0, 72.0),
    "E3":    (108.0, 68.0),
    "E2":    (112.0, 68.0),
    "D_E01": (98.0,  62.0),
    "D_E05": (86.0,  55.0),
    "D_E09": (65.0,  42.0),
    "D_E06": (65.0,  42.0),
    "D_E02": (60.0,  39.0),
    "D_E10": (46.0,  30.0),
    "E1":    (36.0,  24.0),
}

deals = []
reneg_c_rejections = []

for r in awaiting:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    gid = r["group_id"]
    ttype = r["thread_type"]
    turn = r["turn_number"]
    fc, fb, fa = c_floors.get(gid, (54.0, 34.0, 17.0))

    if ttype == "renegotiation":
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        if cur_plan == "C":
            assert ttype == "renegotiation"
            reneg_c_rejections.append({"customer_id": cid})
            continue
        rc, rb, _ = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))
        uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (88.0, 55.0))
        if cur_plan == "B":
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 12.0, uc * 0.88), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p * 1.16, cur_p + 5.0), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 16.0, uc * 0.88), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p + 8.0, ub * 0.88), 2)],
            ]
    elif ttype in ("churn_prevention", "renewal", "plan_change"):
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        rc, rb, ra = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (38.0, 20.0, 9.0))
        uc, _ = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (88.0, 55.0))
        if turn <= 1:
            if cur_plan == "C":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 0.88, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.72, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.48, 2))],
                ]
            elif cur_plan == "B":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc + 4.0, round(cur_p * 1.14, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.85, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.54, 2))],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc + 4.0, round(max(cur_p * 1.75, uc * 0.65), 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 1.22, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.84, 2))],
                ]
        else:
            try:
                c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", cur_p * 0.8))
            except Exception:
                c_price = cur_p * 0.8
            msg = r["message_text"] or ""
            if "Plan C" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price + 1.0), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price * 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", ra],
                ]
            elif "Plan B" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc + 4.0, c_price * 1.28), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price + 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc + 4.0, uc * 0.65), 2)],
                    ["B", rb],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price + 0.50), 2)],
                ]
    elif turn == 0:
        offerings = turn0_menus.get(gid, [["C", 96.0], ["B", 60.0], ["A", 33.0]])
    else:
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", 15.0))
        except Exception:
            c_price = 15.0
        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        if "Plan C" in msg and c_price >= fc - 4.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price * 0.74), 2)],
                ["A", fa],
            ]
        elif c_price >= fb - 2.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price * 1.48), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price + 1.5), 2)],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(fc + 6.0, 2)],
                ["B", fb],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price + 1.5), 2)],
            ]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])

if reneg_c_rejections:
    rej_res = nm.enterprise.reject_enterprise_deal(deals=reneg_c_rejections)
    rej_ok = sum(1 for x in rej_res.get("results", []) if x.get("success"))
    print(f"Closed {rej_ok}/{len(reneg_c_rejections)} remaining C->C seller renegotiations (contracts preserved).")

# 1b. Launch 160 Proactive Seller Renegotiations strictly on Plan A & Plan B -> Plan C Upgrades!
recent_reneg_cids = {
    r["customer_id"]
    for r in nm.query(
        f"SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM enterprise_turns WHERE thread_type='renegotiation' AND day > {nm.vars.current_day - 14}"
    )["rows"]
}

active_ent = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.customer_id, c.group_id, s.plan, s.seat_count, s.effective_price
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed' AND c.customer_type = 'large' AND s.plan IN ('A', 'B')
""")["rows"]

candidates = []
for r in active_ent:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    if cid in open_customer_ids or cid in recent_reneg_cids:
        continue
    gid = r["group_id"]
    cur_p = float(r["effective_price"] or 20.0)
    seats = int(r["seat_count"] or 1)
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (88.0, 55.0))

            msg = r["message_text"] or ""
            if "Plan C" in msg:

            elif "Plan B" in msg:

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print(f"Configuring Week 27 on day {nm.vars.current_day}...")

# Check if any group has multi-day open issues
old_iss = nm.query("SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(days_open) AS max_d FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY 1 HAVING MAX(days_open) > 0")["rows"]
print("Groups with max_days_open > 0:", old_iss)

for t_info in rp.get("tiers", []):

    )

        SELECT MAX(message_id) FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_id
    )
    ORDER BY t.day, t.thread_id
""")

open_customer_ids = {r["customer_id"] for r in ent["rows"]}
awaiting = [r for r in ent["rows"] if r["sender"] != "agent"]
print(f"Found {len(ent['rows'])} open threads, {len(awaiting)} awaiting agent reply.")

turn0_menus = {

    "D_E01": [["C", 142.0], ["B", 90.0],  ["A", 50.0]],
    "D_E05": [["C", 128.0], ["B", 82.0],  ["A", 45.0]],
    "D_E09": [["C", 100.0], ["B", 65.0],  ["A", 36.0]],
    "D_E06": [["C", 96.0],  ["B", 62.0],  ["A", 35.0]],
    "D_E02": [["C", 92.0],  ["B", 60.0],  ["A", 34.0]],
    "D_E10": [["C", 70.0],  ["B", 46.0],  ["A", 28.0]],
    "E1":    [["C", 58.0],  ["B", 38.0],  ["A", 26.0]],
}

# Very high new-lead floors at 100% Tier-7 capacity — only accept high-$/token enterprise seats!
c_floors = {
    "E2":    (90.0, 58.0, 32.0),
    "D_E08": (84.0, 54.0, 30.0),
    "D_E07": (92.0, 60.0, 32.0),
    "D_E04": (84.0, 54.0, 30.0),
    "D_E01": (72.0, 46.0, 26.0),
    "D_E05": (70.0, 45.0, 25.0),
    "D_E03": (92.0, 60.0, 32.0),
    "E3":    (80.0, 52.0, 28.0),
    "D_E02": (58.0, 38.0, 24.0),
    "D_E09": (54.0, 36.0, 22.0),
    "D_E06": (54.0, 36.0, 22.0),
    "D_E10": (52.0, 35.0, 22.0),
    "E1":    (46.0, 33.0, 24.0),
}

ret_min_floors = {
    "E2":    (42.0, 20.0, 9.0),
    "D_E08": (36.0, 18.0, 8.5),
    "D_E07": (36.0, 18.0, 8.5),
    "D_E04": (36.0, 18.0, 8.5),
    "D_E01": (30.0, 15.0, 8.0),
    "D_E05": (30.0, 16.0, 8.0),
    "D_E03": (28.0, 15.0, 8.0),
    "E3":    (28.0, 15.0, 8.0),
    "D_E02": (24.0, 13.0, 7.5),
    "D_E09": (22.0, 12.0, 7.0),
    "D_E06": (23.0, 13.0, 7.5),
    "D_E10": (24.0, 15.0, 8.0),
    "E1":    (28.0, 20.0, 14.0),  # push sub-$18 E1 Plan B up to $28 Plan C or free capacity!

    "D_E03": (168.0, 106.0),
    "D_E07": (152.0, 96.0),
    "D_E04": (136.0, 86.0),
    "D_E08": (126.0, 80.0),
    "E3":    (120.0, 76.0),
    "E2":    (124.0, 76.0),
    "D_E01": (108.0, 68.0),
    "D_E05": (96.0,  62.0),
    "D_E09": (72.0,  46.0),
    "D_E06": (72.0,  46.0),
    "D_E02": (68.0,  43.0),
    "D_E10": (52.0,  34.0),
    "E1":    (40.0,  27.0),
}

deals = []
reneg_c_rejections = []

for r in awaiting:
    cid = r["customer_id"]
    gid = r["group_id"]
    ttype = r["thread_type"]
    turn = r["turn_number"]
    fc, fb, fa = c_floors.get(gid, (64.0, 42.0, 24.0))

    if ttype == "renegotiation":
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        if cur_plan == "C":
            assert ttype == "renegotiation"
            reneg_c_rejections.append({"customer_id": cid})
            continue
        rc, rb, _ = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (30.0, 16.0, 8.0))
        uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (94.0, 60.0))
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", cur_p))
        except Exception:
            c_price = cur_p
        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        if "Plan C" in msg and c_price >= max(rc + 6.0, cur_p + 8.0):
            offerings = [["C", round(max(rc + 6.0, cur_p + 8.0, c_price + 2.0), 2)]]
        elif cur_plan == "B":
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 12.0, uc * 0.84), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p * 1.15, cur_p + 5.0), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 16.0, uc * 0.84), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p + 8.0, ub * 0.84), 2)],
            ]
    elif ttype in ("churn_prevention", "renewal", "plan_change"):
        cur_p = float(r["cur_price"] or 25.0)
        cur_plan = r["cur_plan"] or "B"
        rc, rb, ra = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (30.0, 16.0, 8.0))
        uc, _ = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (94.0, 60.0))
        if turn <= 1:
            if cur_plan == "C":
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc, round(cur_p * 0.88, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.72, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.48, 2))],
                ]
            elif cur_plan == "B":
                # Steer Plan B retention threads strongly into Plan C (+12% only!)
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc + 4.0, round(cur_p * 1.12, 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 0.86, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.54, 2))],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", max(rc + 4.0, round(max(cur_p * 1.70, uc * 0.65), 2))],
                    ["B", max(rb, round(cur_p * 1.20, 2))],
                    ["A", max(ra, round(cur_p * 0.84, 2))],
                ]
        else:
            try:
                c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", cur_p * 0.8))
            except Exception:
                c_price = cur_p * 0.8
            msg = r["message_text"] or ""
            if "Plan C" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc, c_price + 1.0), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price * 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", ra],
                ]
            elif "Plan B" in msg:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc + 4.0, c_price * 1.25), 2)],
                    ["B", round(max(rb, c_price + 0.75), 2)],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
                ]
            else:
                offerings = [
                    ["C", round(max(rc + 4.0, uc * 0.65), 2)],
                    ["B", rb],
                    ["A", round(max(ra, c_price + 0.50), 2)],
                ]
    elif turn == 0:
        offerings = turn0_menus.get(gid, [["C", 116.0], ["B", 75.0], ["A", 42.0]])
    else:
        try:
            c_price = float(json.loads(r["offer_json"] or "{}").get("price", 15.0))
        except Exception:
            c_price = 15.0
        msg = r["message_text"] or ""
        if "Plan C" in msg and c_price >= fc - 4.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price + 2.5), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price * 0.74), 2)],
                ["A", fa],
            ]
        elif c_price >= fb - 2.0:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(max(fc, c_price * 1.48), 2)],
                ["B", round(max(fb, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price * 0.65), 2)],
            ]
        else:
            offerings = [
                ["C", round(fc + 6.0, 2)],
                ["B", fb],
                ["A", round(max(fa, c_price + 2.0), 2)],
            ]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])

if reneg_c_rejections:

# 1b. Launch remaining Proactive Seller Renegotiations on Plan A & Plan B -> Plan C Upgrades!
recent_reneg_cids = {
    r["customer_id"]
    for r in nm.query(
        f"SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM enterprise_turns WHERE thread_type='renegotiation' AND day > {nm.vars.current_day - 14}"

for r in active_ent:

    if cid in open_customer_ids or cid in recent_reneg_cids:
        continue
    gid = r["group_id"]
    cur_p = float(r["effective_price"] or 20.0)
    seats = int(r["seat_count"] or 1)
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (94.0, 60.0))

        upside = (uc - cur_p) * seats
        candidates.append((upside, cid, gid, cur_p, r["plan"], seats))

candidates.sort(reverse=True)
reneg_batch = candidates[:200]
reneg_seats = 0
for upside, cid, gid, cur_p, cur_plan, seats in reneg_batch:
    uc, ub = upgrade_c_targets.get(gid, (94.0, 60.0))
    rc, rb, _ = ret_min_floors.get(gid, (30.0, 16.0, 8.0))
    p_c = round(max(rc + 8.0, cur_p + 12.0, uc), 2)
    p_b = round(max(rb + 4.0, cur_p + 6.0, ub), 2)
    if cur_plan == "B":
        offerings = [["C", p_c], ["B", max(p_b, round(cur_p * 1.18, 2))]]
    else:
        offerings = [["C", p_c], ["B", p_b]]
    deals.append([cid, offerings])
    reneg_seats += seats

print(f"Added {len(reneg_batch)} Plan A/B -> C upgrade renegotiations covering {reneg_seats:,} seats.")

if deals:

    results = deal_res.get("results", [])
    ok_cnt = sum(1 for x in results if x.get("success"))
    print(f"send_enterprise_deal: {ok_cnt}/{len(results)} succeeded")
    if ok_cnt < len(results):
        print("Failures:", [x for x in results if not x.get("success")][:5])

print("set_usage_quotas:", nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=170, B=380, C=1350))

# Nudge Plan B retail promos slightly tighter & Plan C promos slightly warmer to push B->C upgrades as PMI rises (45.9)!
print("set_promotion:", nm.pricing.set_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={},
    by_group_plan={
        "S2":    {"B": 12.0, "C": 50.0},   # B=$130, C=$249
        "S3":    {"B": 14.0, "C": 50.0},   # B=$128, C=$249
        "D_S04": {"B": 48.0, "C": 115.0},  # B=$94,  C=$184

        "D_S05": {"B": 64.0},              # B=$78
        "D_S01": {"B": 72.0},              # B=$70
    }

# 3. Scale global operations slightly to $105K/d so open issues stay instantaneous across 2.26M seats
print("set_daily_spend:", nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=105000.0, development=50000.0))

print("post_social_media:", nm.marketing.post_social_media(

))
